# Test config file errors

# 1. Missing config file fails with non-zero exit code
! exec test-app --config-file nonexistent.yaml
stderr 'cannot read config file'

# 2. Unknown field in config file fails strict validation
! exec test-app --config-file invalid.yaml
stderr 'unknown field "unrecognized_setting"'

-- invalid.yaml --
port: 8080
unrecognized_setting: "boom"
